name: Nha Trang
summary: A coastal city in south-central Vietnam, and where Larry spent about his first two months in the country, from around September 1964: "we were there about 2 months, they didn't know where to put us." Ron Tototz and Parr were with him. "Nha Trang, the most beautiful place you ever saw." The beach photographs VN-0021 and VN-0022 were taken at "Beachhut #3 or 4": "For 25 cents we could get 3 large shrimp. they were delicious". Larry also remembers a loss on this beach: the medic for his unit, who went into the water and was pulled under by a riptide. He first said the medic was from Nebraska, and later "from Kanas or Nebraska and never seen water."
researchNotes: Which unit or facility Larry was attached to at Nha Trang has not been identified; his own 'they didn't know where to put us' suggests a replacement or holding status rather than a unit posting. The coordinates mark the city; his location within it is unknown. The drowned medic (ledger #14, issue #61): 2026-08-15 "A medic died here that was from Nebraska" (giscus-vn-0021-c18032383); 2026-09-03 "The guy was from Kanas or Nebraska and never seen water. He was Army. He was our medic for my unit. It was during the first couple week Nha Trang in '64" (giscus-vn-0021-c18259987). Corrected 2026-09-14 after research/site-audit-2026-09-14.md: the summary gave Nebraska alone. Negative results, so the searches are not repeated: every U.S. death for September, October and November 1964 has been read at record level, and the Nebraska and Kansas casualty lists and the national roll have been checked for a drowning or a medic, all negative (research/people/drowned-medic-nha-trang.md, passes of 2026-08-16, 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-09). 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0018-c18415793, -c18415813): the girl in VN-0018 "is one of the girls that was selling shrimp. You could get a shrimp 6 - 7 niches long and a beer for 25 cents." The price agrees with his 2026-08-15 figure while describing a different purchase; both are kept as given. VN-0130 ("I think this is Nha Trang") and VN-0090 ("Nha Trang area?") are not linked here: both are tentative and one is a confirmation still to ask.
